title: Normalized compactification words and proper/open outside contexts
statement: Fix a prime l and finite extension E of Q_l. With the typed system/integral interpretations and expression domains [def-sf-integral-system-expression-domain], define the compactification word B_c as compactSupport f c of the one input variable. The geometric witness uses the existing finite-type and quasi-compactness classes. Define its forward system refinement as inverseOrZero [def-sf-inverse-or-zero] of the specified reverse refinement [def-sf-completed-shriek-refinement-maps]. An outside context is inductively the hole, a proper push, or a quasi-compact open shriek. Define substitution, its composite evaluation functor, and the canonical evaluation associator isomorphism by recursion. For realization data [def-sf-integral-system-realization-data], the outside-coordinate realization is the inverse total-limit image of this associator, the comparison of the substituted word, then the integral associator. The bundled finite-type and quasi-compact structure-map instances identify the same Over structure map. These are exactly the existing constructions, relocated without changing any body or signature.
